This time I had to walk in front of the food preparation area and try to guess which were the ones I would like... eventually I ordered 6 plates and the meal was great! 

My recommendation to the restaurant is to have a visual menu for tourist, since the staff are not 100% fluent in English, it can be somewhat difficult to communicate your ideas.
